basis: c.1841 tithe apportionment for the parishes of Llandough, Cogan and Leckwith (NLW 4542756; map 4622411, dated 1842)
holding: Cydfin / Tŷ Mawr (Great House Farm): 36 tithe parcels, 30 in Llandough-juxta-Penarth parish (tithe 196-267) and 6 in Leckwith parish (tithe 275-281), 119a 2r 30p in all
rule: Every record, finding, draft and edit about this land names the parcel(s) it concerns (tithe no., OS 1:2500 field no., HM Land Registry title no., or deed schedule item), or states 'parcel not identified' and what would identify it.

parcel_tie_levels.named: the record itself names this parcel
parcel_tie_levels.inferred: tied by reasoning; the reason is given
parcel_tie_levels.not identified: the record names no parcel; what would identify it is given

neighbouring.note: not one of the 36; linked by some later accounts to the land of a 1939 grazing agreement (not checked)

open_questions: 1824 plan 19 to 1841 field-level concordance (Glamorgan Archives DB/E/1, DB/E/2)
OS 1:2500 field numbers (Glamorgan XLVII.6, 1878) for all 36
title numbers for the HM Land Registry index polygons round Llandough church
plans of the 1916 tenancy, the 1926 Cardiff Corporation conveyance and the 1938 Western Ground Rents conveyance
